notes: DeepSeek Harness TUI submits text during running status through agent.steer. The durable inbox records the exact follow-up in next-step, and the agent loop claims it inside the open turn before writing the one final turn/end. The DSH parser maps turn/start to working, direct user/message to a non-terminal user signal, and only the final completed turn/end to ready. Raw-transcript assertions prove that the follow-up reached the queue and was consumed inside one turn; the phase hold proves that the daemon did not flicker to ready or waiting at arrival.
